note: Structural budgets are exact and final (Plan 4 Task 15). Timing and memory budgets are written by `run.mjs --init-budgets` from a real measurement as max(median x 1.5, max), rounded up, and are checked with a noise multiplier (see run.mjs --help). Empty until the first measurement.

startup.networkCalls.why: Brief s14: nothing contacts the marketplace at workbench or main-process startup.

startup.fsCallsAtConstruction.why: The install service is built eagerly by the main process; its constructor and the 60 s recovery deferral must do no file work.

startup.processesSpawned.why: No Hermes or other child process at startup.

startup.storeFilesRead.why: Store contents (SKILL.md, manifests) are read only on install, enable or permission display, never at startup.

installed.storeFilesRead.why: installed() is the lightweight index: the lockfile only, no per-item file reads.

reconcileSchedule.initialDelayMs.why: The first background reconcile is armed 30 s after start, never earlier.

lockfile.readsForInstalled.why: installed() reads the lockfile exactly once.

lockfile.parse200.ms.why: max(median x 1.5, max) of the first measurement, taken on a loaded shared machine (see machine.loadAverageAtStart); a later run compares its median against this x noiseMultiplier.
